name.en-US: Sermons for the Festivals of the Saints (Mount Melleray)
name.pt-BR: Sermões para as festas dos santos (Mount Melleray)

description.en-US: Sermons of Bernard for the feasts of St. Andrew, the Conversion of St. Paul, the Purification, St. Victor, the Annunciation, SS. Peter and Paul, the Assumption, St. Michael and All Saints, in the English of a priest of Mount Melleray (Dublin, 1925), volume three of his Sermons for the Seasons and Principal Festivals of the Year.
description.pt-BR: Sermões de São Bernardo na tradução inglesa de um sacerdote de Mount Melleray (Dublin).

en-US.translator: A priest of Mount Melleray (Ailbe Luddy)

sources.edition: St. Bernard's Sermons for the Seasons and Principal Festivals of the Year, translated from the original Latin by a Priest of Mount Melleray, vol. 3 (Dublin: Browne and Nolan, 1925).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR cleaned by script, not proofread; the running heads are stripped by pattern and the translator's occasional footnotes are not kept. The translator (a priest of Mount Melleray, Ailbe Luddy) divides and orders the sermons by the liturgical calendar as listed here, which differs from the Latin book.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in 1925, before 1931: public domain in the US.
